title: Terraform module: HSM-backed KMS <> Vault secret sync and lifecycle orchestration
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a reusable Terraform module that provisions HSM-backed KMS keys, configures Vault auto-unseal and sealwrap with the HSM/KMS provider, and provides a secrets-sync operator wiring for Secret Manager and Vault. The module must support upgrade-safe workflows (schema migrations), health checks, and an operator hook for rotation and emergency key rollback.
acceptance_criteria: Module exposes inputs for cloud provider HSM KMS configuration, Vault auto-unseal config, and operator service account/roles.

A reference deployment (dev) can be created with the module that sets up: HSM KMS key, Vault auto-unseal (sealwrap), and a Kubernetes SecretsSync deployment that mirrors specified Vault paths to Kubernetes secrets or Secrets Manager.
Upgrades run with no secret downtime: key rotation and module updates verified via canary namespace and automated smoke tests.
Module includes Terraform state migration notes and examples for moving from existing non-HSM KMS resources to HSM-backed keys.
Health-check endpoints and Terraform outputs for monitoring dashboards are produced (healthcheck URL / Cloudwatch metrics or equivalent).
Security review checklist completed and documented in the module README and Confluence page.
technical_notes: Design choice: module will support AWS CloudHSM + AWS KMS custom key store pattern and GCP/CryptoKey HSM-equivalent via provider-agnostic inputs to keep multi-cloud flexibility.
Vault auto-unseal will be configured using the KMS/CloudHSM feature where available; for environments without KMS HSM, module will still provision standard KMS key with a warning flag.
We avoid storing raw unseal keys in Terraform state. State only contains encrypted references and policy ARNs. Use data sources and external operator secrets for ephemeral bootstrap.

Rotation strategy: support scheduled rotation via operator trigger with grace period config and automatic rewrap of existing sealed blobs. Provide a rollback flow that re-publishes previous key as primary where supported.

Trade-offs: Full migration automation for Provider A->B (e.g., AWS->GCP) would be complex; initial scope supports in-place HSM enablement and rotation, cross-cloud migration deferred to follow-up ticket.

Health checks implemented via a lightweight lambda/k8s job that validates: KMS encrypt/decrypt, Vault unseal path test, and SecretsSync reconciliation latency. These are surfaced as metrics and a short-circuit alert on failures.
implementation_plan: 1) Module scaffold: variables, provider blocks (abstracted), and example usage in /examples/dev.
2) Resources: create KMS key with custom key store for CloudHSM where available; create IAM roles/policies for Vault AutoUnseal and operator service account.
3) Vault config: Terraform-managed Vault mount and 'seal' block config template; do not write unseal keys to state. Provide a templated Kubernetes Secret manifest for bootstrap handled by operator.
4) SecretsSync: Helm chart values + Kubernetes manifests to deploy a small operator that watches Vault paths and mirrors secrets to Secrets Manager or k8s secrets with RBAC controls.
5) Health checks: implement a small job/lambda and CloudWatch (or equivalent) metric emission; add Terraform outputs for alert rule IDs and healthcheck endpoints.
6) Tests: unit tests via kitchen-terraform / terratest for resource creation and basic smoke tests for encryption/decryption and Vault unseal.
7) Documentation: README with upgrade steps, migration notes, and security checklist. Example PR templates for upgrade rollouts.
8) Hook up CI: Terraform fmt, validate, and plan in PR; run terratest in integration stage against ephemeral account or local stack where possible.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): Deploy module to a sandbox VPC using dev KMS/CVMHSM. Run smoke tests and verify SecretsSync reconciles sample secret paths. Monitor health metrics for 48 hours.
Phase 2 (pilot): Select 2 non-critical production stacks; enable HSM-backed keys with traffic routed to new key via dual-write/dual-read where possible. Validate rotation and rollback procedures.
Phase 3 (gradual): Gradually onboard other services over 2-3 weeks. Use automatic rollback if health checks exceed failure thresholds.
Emergency rollback: Terraform plan + operator tool will allow marking previous key as primary and re-sealing Vault with prior key material (documented runbook).
Post-rollout: Run audit and key usage reports; schedule a security review and run a postmortem on any anomalies.
test_plan: Unit: terraform validate and fmt; module-level linting.
Integration: terratest creates KMS key + custom key store, deploys Vault micro instance, verifies auto-unseal and SecretsSync behavior.
Upgrade test: Apply a module change that modifies KMS key rotation window; run canary migration and ensure no secrets lost and latency within SLO.
Chaos: simulate Vault leader restart and HSM availability blips; healthcheck job must detect and alert, operator must retry until reconciliation.
Security tests: verify no unsealed keys in state, confirm least-privilege IAM roles, and run static policy checks.
